America shouldn’t wait for China’s next AI announcement to get moving.

My take: Build the chips, power the data centers, develop the talent, and protect the technology that gives us an advantage.

Smart export controls belong alongside faster construction and serious research.

#RaisinaDialogue2026 | Who wins the chips race?

#Semiconductors sit at the centre of #geopolitical competition. As demand rises and export controls tighten, governments and industry are rethinking how chips are designed, manufactured, and secured to build resilient supply

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently appeared on the popular podcast hosted by Lex Fridman, discussing the massive investment opportunities driven by artificial intelligence (AI), the rise of Taiwan's semiconductor industry, and the story behind the partnership established with TSMC https://t.co/yXkq3J7Av3
